As Brighte's Data Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps our data reliable, scalable, and AI-ready - our ELT pipelines (Airflow + dbt), Snowflake Data Warehouse, and data architecture.
You'll work closely with our Analytics Engineering and Analytics teams with one clear goal: high quality, traceable data that our business can trust and act on.

Develop and maintain Brighte’s data infrastructure
Maintain and augment ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) pipeline, our data architecture and relational data models
Implement testing suites and control mechanisms to ensure there is ‘a single source of truth’ for our business
Collaborate with our IT Operations team to maintain Snowflake platform administration
Take ownership of Snowflake database administration
Identify, define and implement data process improvements to generate value with existing and potential data sources
Champion a data-driven company culture
Architect for real time pipelines and AI use cases
Clearly communicate ideas and work to different stakeholders and identify opportunities for leveraging data to drive solutions

Technical skills

Airflow —hands-on use (must have)

You bring an agile mindset you move fast without cutting corners, and you're comfortable juggling priorities in a dynamic environment

You're a strong communicator and can translate technical concepts for any audience, whether that's a data team or a business leader

At Brighte, diversity isn’t just something we talk about, it’s something we live every day. We believe that innovation thrives when people feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work. Our inclusive culture is built on respect, collaboration, and the celebration of individuality.

title: Finance & Data Analyst
description:
Where accounting meets data intelligence - you build the bridge.
This is a rare role. It sits at the intersection of financial accounting and the data-driven future for a well established vertically integrated luxury business spanning raw material sourcing, artisan manufacturing, and multi-boutique retail.
If you have the accounting fundamentals and you're curious about, studying, or already working in - automated analytics, AI, or data intelligence, this was written for you.
Finance background is non-negotiable.
Before anything else - if you do not have hands-on finance experience owning BAS preparation, month-end journals, and compliance end-to-end, this role is not for you. The accounting foundation is not a stepping stone. It is the job.
The business operates across multiple entities and three states. The finance function is being deliberately reimagined - systems will be structured, and the cost intelligence layer for the product range is a focus. This role sits at the centre.
In this role you own the technical accounting engine - compliance, month-end, costings, COGS, and reporting. The mandate sitting underneath all of that is to consider 'can this be automated?' before accepting old manual processes - and to help build the answer.
The diverse product cycle journey includes traditional artisan elements that require precision and craft, while there is a significant data-driven layer as the foundational element deliberately and urgently alongside them. Most finance people never get close to a product like this.
The Role
As Finance & Data Analyst you are responsible for the technical accounting engine of the business - compliance, month-end, costings, COGS, and reporting - across a multi-entity group structure.
The finance function is a focus. Xero is being optimised. Payroll & HR systems are being re-imagined. The cost model for the product range does not yet exist as a finance-owned document. You will help build it.
As systems bed in, the role evolves. The compliance work stays yours - but the time you spend on it shrinks as automation takes over the repeatable work. You shift from doing reconciliations to building the systems that do them. Month one to month eight: that is a tracked plan, not a vague aspiration.
What We're Looking For
The non-negotiables:
3+ years owning a finance function end-to-end
BAS preparation experience
Advanced Xero - multi-entity experience strongly preferred
Month-end journals drafted independently
Australian GST and payroll compliance - solid and current
The data and automation spectrum:
We are not looking for one specific profile. From genuinely curious and just getting started, to building with Power BI, n8n, or Spotlight, to technically proficient in Python or SQL alongside your accounting - all are welcome. Tell us honestly where you sit and where you want to go.
What will make you stand out: you can point to something specific you have automated or built in a finance context, however small. A report. A reconciliation. A workflow. Something real.
Manufacturing or product business background is a strong advantage - you understand how cost flows through a physical product.
How You Work - This Matters as Much as What You Know
This role operates inside a function being rebuilt in real time. We need someone who moves with the business, not ahead or behind it.
You communicate upward clearly and proactively.
When implementing something new, you align first, then act.
You manage your own workload with structure - deadlines are visible, progress is reported, problems are surfaced early.
You present problems with a recommended solution attached.
If you work autonomously but collaboratively - moving with pace while keeping the right people informed - this will feel natural. If you prefer to work independently and present outcomes at the end, this is probably not the right fit.
Why This Role
Own the numbers behind a product that goes from raw material to boutique window
A genuine mandate to bring data intelligence and automation into the finance function
Real variety: compliance, costings, COGS, automation builds, inventory intelligence
Salary flexible for the right combination of skills, we are seeking talent

About Openmesh and Xnode
Today a handful of corporations control 90% of the world's data and IT infrastructure and we are expected to trust them. This is not just bad for business; it's bad for everyone. Information asymmetry has led to social inequality, scandals, polarization, and corruption. Sometimes, it has even led to war. Centralized data control acts as a potential chokepoint for innovation, raises privacy concerns, and creates a bottleneck for the free flow of data.
Openmesh is a cutting-edge new open-source cloud infrastructure and a global open data network aimed at storing important global data without a middleman. It is the largest open web3 data lake, covering approximately 80% of the entire crypto and web3 ecosystem today. In 2023 and 2024, we aim to expand our data coverage to include public health and scientific research data.
Openmesh enables anyone to create their own decentralized data cloud, connect globally, share data securely, slash deployment costs, and automate data cloud setup. The Openmesh Network is designed to collect, store, process, stream, and provide data connectivity for anyone, anywhere, anytime, without the need for registration, licensing, or payments. Think of Openmesh as the internet's open data fabric. It grants universal access and prevents interferences created by regulators, governments, corporations, and even its own creators. The possibilities are endless.
Core Products
Our flagship product, Xnode, is an integral part of this vision, offering a revolutionary platform for developers to build decentralized data clouds. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Integrations & Solutions Group (AU remote)
description:
Company Description
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Where and how you can work
Our flagship campus is in Sydney, with a second campus in Melbourne and co-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and Auckland, NZ. You have flexibility in how and where you work — whether that's from one of our spaces, from home, or a mix of both. This role is remote-friendly within Australia, so you can choose the setup that empowers you and your team to do your best work.
Job Description
About the team
We aim to build the world’s richest Ecosystem of apps for visual design and communications that supercharge Canva’s ability to meet the diverse needs of a billion users and drive Canva’s MAU growth.
With the proliferation of innovations in generative AI and as large organizations have increasingly complex workflows to manage their designs, Canva is well poised to become the platform that simplifies access and discovery of services related to visual design. We are already working with hundreds of developers to enable access to these exciting products with our Apps SDK and Canva public REST API!
As one of the groups in Ecosystem, the Integrations and Solutions Group builds Canva's AI integration layer — the infrastructure that connects Canva's design capabilities to the world's leading AI assistants. Our teams own the MCP platform, AI-optimised tools and APIs, evaluation frameworks, and the agent architecture that powers millions of AI-driven design interactions. We work directly with partners like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and we're in the middle of a strategic shift from protocol-first integrations toward intelligent, Canva-hosted design agents.
As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you'll play a critical role in defining how AI platforms experience Canva — driving the technical standards, evaluation frameworks, and architectural decisions that ensure our integrations are reliable, measurable, and evolving with a rapidly changing ecosystem.
What you’d be doing in this role
As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
At the moment, this role is focused on:
Drive the design and evolution of AI-ready tools and APIs that enable LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others) to reliably interact with Canva's design capabilities — defining the patterns and standards that other teams adopt for tool descriptions, payload structures, and intent-based interfaces. Pioneer agent-to-agent communication approaches.
Own and evolve evaluation frameworks that systematically measure tool-use accuracy across platforms — defining what "good" looks like for proxy-based fast evals and real-client production evals, and ensuring these frameworks scale as we add platforms and capabilities.
Shape Canva's agent architecture — making strategic technical decisions about where intelligence should live (in external LLMs vs Canva-hosted agents), building the orchestration layers that allow third-party providers to invoke Canva's design tools at scale, and driving automation of complex workflows like marketing campaigns.
Define and build observability systems that give multiple teams visibility into how AI assistants consume Canva's tools in production — identifying failure patterns, setting quality benchmarks, and closing the loop between production data and continuous improvement.
Work across team and platform boundaries — proactively identifying problems not yet defined, understanding behavioural quirks across LLM platforms, and driving solutions that span the AI Integrations, API Capabilities, and Workflow Integrations teams.
Influence integration strategy with AI partners and internal teams — contributing to technical direction with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and shaping how Canva's broader engineering organisation builds for AI consumption.
You're probably a match if
You've shipped LLM-powered systems into production and can quantify your impact — things like improving tool-call accuracy from X% to Y%, reducing agent error rates, cutting latency by Z%, or measurably improving user outcomes through better AI integration. We care about results, not just launches.
You proactively find and solve problems others haven't defined yet — you've identified gaps in how LLMs consume tools or APIs, scoped the problem across teams, and driven the fix without waiting for someone to hand you a brief.
You've built or owned evaluation pipelines end-to-end — designing metrics, building benchmarking infrastructure, and using data to make architectural decisions about AI integrations at scale.
You set technical standards that others follow — whether that's tool design patterns, API contracts for AI agents, documentation quality, or observability practices. Your work becomes the reference point.
You can connect external ecosystem changes to internal strategy — when a new LLM capability drops or a partner shifts their architecture, you can quickly assess the implications for Canva and re-prioritise accordingly.
You're proficient in Python and familiar with ML frameworks, and equally comfortable working with TypeScript/Node.js and cloud infrastructure (Cloudflare Workers, AWS, or similar).
You thrive in cross-team, partner-facing work — influencing engineering, product, and external AI platform teams to shape integration strategy. You're comfortable operating across team boundaries without formal authority.
You're energised by ambiguity and pace — the AI ecosystem is evolving rapidly, and you bring clarity and momentum rather than waiting for direction.
Additional Information
Don't tick all the boxes? Don't worry about that - nobody does!  
We’d still love to hear from you! At Canva, we know that great engineers come from a variety of backgrounds, and we value passion, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as specific experience. If you're excited about this role but don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply, you might a great fit in ways you didn’t expect!
What's in it for you?
Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
Here's a taste of what's on offer:
Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally
Check out  lifeatcanva.com for more info.
Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
All interviews are conducted virtually

title: NSW - Sydney - AI Engineer
description:
Help shape what’s next in AI deliveryAt Altis, we’re focused helping clients move beyond AI experimentation and into practical, production-ready outcomes
We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our team, working across the full AI and machine learning solution lifecycle from problem definition and design through to build, deployment, and optimisation.
This is more than a technical delivery role. We’re looking for someone who can combine strong engineering capability with sound judgement, commercial awareness, and a modern advisory mindset. Someone who can work closely with clients, understand real business challenges, and translate them into effective AI and ML solutions that are scalable, governed, and built for the real world.
What you’ll be doing
In this role, you’ll work with clients and internal teams to design, build, and deliver AI and machine learning solutions across a range of use cases and environments.
Your role:
Design, build, test, and deploy AI and ML solutions across the full lifecycle, from proof of concept through to production implementation
Apply modern AI/ML engineering practices, including data preparation, feature engineering, model and prompt development, deployment, monitoring, and optimisation
Translate business problems into practical AI and ML solutions, working directly with client data, technology, and business stakeholders
Embed responsible AI and governance controls into solution design and delivery, aligned to client risk, compliance, and ethical requirements
Contribute technical credibility to conversations around AI strategy, architecture, and governance
Support proposals, scoping, and capability assessments as part of business development activities
Develop reusable artefacts, patterns, and documentation to enable consistent and scalable delivery across engagements
Share knowledge and help uplift AI capability across the broader Altis team
Contribute to Altis AI intellectual property, thought leadership, and external market positioning as opportunities arise
What we’re looking for
We’re looking for someone who brings strong technical depth, end-to-end delivery experience, and the ability to work confidently with clients in complex environments.
What you ideally bring:
5+ years’ experience designing and delivering solutions in a commercial or consulting environment
Proven experience taking AI/ML solutions end-to-end, from problem definition and proof of concept through to production deployment and ongoing optimisation
The ability to assess a client problem and recommend the right approach, whether that is traditional machine learning, generative AI, or a combination of both
Experience working directly with clients and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, practical business language
A strong understanding of responsible AI, including governance, risk, ethical considerations, and challenges such as hallucination, bias, and data privacy
Technical capability
You’ll bring strong hands-on capability across modern AI engineering practices and tooling, including:
Strong Python skills
Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation
Practical experience building LLM-powered solutions, including prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and agentic patterns such as tool use and multi-step reasoning
Familiarity with LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, including context management, token economics, and cost optimisation
Experience with MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model deployment, and performance monitoring in production
Familiarity with REST API design and integration patterns to connect AI solutions with client systems
Experience with AWS and/or GCP, containerisation, and CI/CD pipelines
Exposure to large-scale data processing, streaming, and workflow orchestration tools
Additional requirements
Regular domestic travel will be required to support client delivery and business development
The mindset that matters
Technical strength is essential, but it is only part of the picture.
We’re also looking for someone who brings:
A practical, solutions-focused approach
Strong judgement and the ability to navigate ambiguity
Curiosity and a genuine interest in emerging AI technologies
A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge
The confidence to engage senior stakeholders and provide credible recommendations
A commitment to quality, responsible delivery, and continuous improvement
Why this role matters
This role sits at the heart of how we deliver AI outcomes for clients.
You’ll play a key role in shaping how AI solutions are designed, delivered, and scaled across engagements, while helping build Altis’ broader capability in a fast-moving and strategically important area. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful problems, influence client outcomes, and help define what good looks like in modern AI delivery.
Why join Altis?
At Altis, you’ll work with a team that values curiosity, innovation, and practical impact.
You’ll have the opportunity to solve real client challenges, contribute to the growth of our AI capability, and work across a mix of delivery, advisory, and capability-building activities. We’re a collaborative team that supports each other, encourages fresh thinking, and values people who can combine technical excellence with commercial and client awareness.
Your next chapter starts here
If you’re excited by the opportunity to design and deliver responsible, high-value AI solutions in a consulting environment, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Company Description Join the team redefining how the world experiences design. Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora,你好, hallo, vítejte! Thanks for stopping by.

You have flexibility in how and where you work — whether that's from one of our spaces, from home, or a mix of both. This role is remote-friendly within Australia, so you can choose the setup that empowers you and your team to do your best work. Job Description
About the Group/Team Canva's AI Platform Group serves as the foundation for AI innovation across the company, and achieving our GenAI ambitions depends on its ability to scale effectively. Within this group, the AI Enablement teams provide critical solution expertise to researchers and AI builders globally, helping them navigate platform capabilities, apply expert domain knowledge, optimise implementations, and accelerate the journey from experimentation to production. These teams bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and reliable, production-ready features, ensuring that innovation translates into real user value.
About the Role/Specialty Please note, this is not a model building role This role sits at the intersection of solution expertise and platform engineering, requiring deep technical expertise across ML domains combined with strong platform knowledge.
The senior MLE will context-switch between facilitating model evaluations, data pipeline, optimising inference performance and working directly with product teams building solutions. The nature of enablement work demands someone who operates as a force multiplier, finding satisfaction not just in solving technical problems but in enabling others to move faster. The role operates in a high-velocity environment where priorities shift rapidly based on team needs, requiring both technical excellence and pragmatic judgment.
This combination of deep expertise and adaptive problem-solving is critical to accelerating the delivery of GenAI capabilities across Canva, removing friction from the path to production and ensuring product teams across the company can ship AI-powered features at the pace and quality our ambitions require. What you’ll do (responsibilities): Responsibilities will evolve as Canva's needs change, but here's what the role will focus on initially: Act as a solution expert across ML domains including evaluations, training, inference, data pipelines, labelling, and optimisation Work directly alongside product teams as a trusted partner, helping them navigate technical challenges and arrive at effective solutions Provide expert guidance on platform capabilities, helping teams understand what's possible and how to get there efficiently Develop blueprints, patterns, and paved roads that allow other teams to follow proven approaches and accelerate their own implementations Debug and resolve complex issues, identifying root causes and sharing learnings broadly Balance hands-on problem solving with strategic thinking about how to scale enablement impact across the organisation
You're probably a match if you have any of the following: Strong Python expertise with experience in ML frameworks Experience working with Kubernetes Experience or knowledge of building data pipelines Experience or knowledge of model evaluations Experience with inference optimisation and serving infrastructure Experience supporting or working closely with research, data science, or product teams Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills across the full ML stack Ability to context-switch effectively across multiple concurrent projects Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to varied audiences A collaborative mindset with a focus on enabling others to succeed Additional Information Don't tick all the boxes? At Canva, we know that great engineers come from a variety of backgrounds, and we value passion, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as specific experience. Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
